summary: The content describes the implementation of a History user control in a web application, including various UI components, their properties, and event handling methods.
purpose: To manage and display historical data related to a specific topic within the web application, including searching and refreshing options.

workflows.name: SelectHistoryList
steps: Check if UserSession is null, if so, cancel the operation.
If UserSession exists, set InputParameters for session, ETopicID, and HistoryType.
Set visibility of spnRefreshBtns and pnlRef based on DisplayButtons property.
Display reference label using data from ETopics

workflows.name: SearchHistory
steps: Cache the UserSession if it is not null.
Redirect the user based on USE_YARP configuration.

conditions: If UserSession is null, cancel the selection operation.
Set visibility of elements based on DisplayButtons.
